diagnosis.reasoning: Request rate and prompt token rate roughly tripled while request shape, prefix cache hit rate, and preemption are all unchanged, so no internal mechanism is misbehaving. KV cache usage stayed low (0.27), ruling out cache pressure or preemption; the TTFT blowup is almost entirely queue_time growth as 269 requests wait behind a saturated running batch. Queueing and the inflated batch composition are the proximate transmitters of the exogenous load increase, with prefill_time only mildly elevated.
